facts.text: Few recorded incidents in ten million operating hours say little about detector performance unless the number of relevant encounters and the completeness of incident recording are known.
facts.quote: "Few recorded incidents in ten million operating hours" says little about detector performance unless the denominator of relevant encounters and the recording completeness are known.

facts.text: Existing warning-system field history is censored because warnings may cause operators to brake, leaving few natural examples of what would have happened without intervention.
facts.quote: An existing warning may cause the operator to brake, so the data contain few natural examples of what would have happened without intervention

facts.text: Existing warning-system logs are open-loop evidence: the logs cannot show how the machine and operator would have behaved once automatic braking intervenes.
facts.quote: logs cannot show how machine and operator would have behaved once braking intervenes.

facts.text: Existing warning-system logs are biased toward normal operation.
facts.quote: The logs are biased toward normal operation

facts.text: Near-misses in which an existing warning was ignored are the most valuable warning-system records, but these events are often not logged with ground truth.
facts.quote: the near-misses where the warning was ignored, the most valuable records, are often not logged with ground truth.

facts.text: An existing warning product has field evidence for perception and operator notification.
facts.quote: The warning product has field evidence for perception and operator notification

facts.text: An existing warning product has no field evidence for automatic command timing, brake-pressure build-up, friction interaction, machine stability during intervention, or unintended-braking hazards.
facts.quote: it has none for automatic command timing, brake-pressure build-up, friction interaction, machine stability during intervention or unintended-braking hazards.

facts.text: The complete chain from detection through decision, brake command, brake dynamics, and stopping outcome has never been exercised in the existing warning product's field history.
facts.quote: The chain detection, decision, brake command, brake dynamics, stopping outcome has never been exercised in the field.

facts.text: The appropriate claim for existing warning-system field history is that the history validates selected inputs and submodels and supports the representativeness of the scenario distribution, not that the history validates the automatic-braking simulator.
facts.quote: "field history validates selected inputs and submodels and supports the representativeness of the scenario distribution", not "field history validates the automatic-braking simulator". **Expert opinion**.

facts.text: No standard or assessor statement explicitly accepting a legacy system's field history as the reference for validating a simulator was found.
facts.quote: A standard or assessor statement explicitly accepting a legacy system's field history as the reference for validating a simulator

facts.text: No earth-moving-machine authority accepting warning-system fleet history as the principal validation basis for an automatic-braking simulation was found.
facts.quote: an earth-moving-machine authority accepting a warning-system fleet history as the principal validation basis for an automatic-braking simulation: **not found**.
